### Architect · Answer

Event: `4518c8c4dca7222e95fa582b26f03c9d` · 2026-09-26T08:08:45Z

> 1 of 2, A-34 account-0 chain: CONFIRMED, servers package. AdmitKey::of keys account 0 by badge (admit.rs:70). Minted::share stops folding when the requester's key changes (minted.rs:163-171). So each self-minted link looks like a new client and opens a fresh bucket. The exposure is a compromised system-class caller (sshd, netd, or a driver fed hostile input). It can take every State bucket of a 9P server and starve every other client, users included. That is availability across principals, not an escape.
> RULE, R26 (admission fairness) on servers/serving.md: "Within account 0, every capability minted through a root badge (one below FIRST_MINTED_BADGE, given by whoever set the server up) counts in that root's share, however many links deep and whoever holds it. A chain of self-mints spends one share. System callers get separate shares only from separate root badges, which the manifest gives. A capability used under a non-zero account is keyed by that account, as now." So the steward minting for a lease's agent still gives the agent a share of its own.
> FIX: share() walks parent links to the root for an account-0 caller. keyd needs no change, since it allows no chain.
> TEST: a libs/rt host test. An account-0 caller chains N links and floods; the chain holds one bucket's worth, and a second client is still admitted. A mutation restoring the stop-at-key-change fold fails it.

### Architect · Answer

Event: `cd3f2f2d7634b2e9d5f20efcfd340036` · 2026-09-26T08:08:45Z

> 2 of 2, rollback on a discarded reply: a TEST GAP. The rollback runs after finish() makes a real reply, so a host test of answer_common cannot reach it, and a helper test would not catch dropping the call in serve_with. The gate is a bench case, ninep-newconn-discard: a client makes new_connection replies undeliverable (its handle table full, so accepted(1) fails) more times than its State admission, and a normal new_connection then still succeeds. A mutation that drops forget() fails it. It goes in the servers package, test-only.
> STATUS LINE on servers/serving.md, minting section: "Status: built · partly tested: the rollback on a discarded reply is tested through unmint and keyd's grant, not through the 9P skeleton's serve path". It links docs/todo/ninep-discard-rollback-test.md until the case lands.
